# Waveform proportion review recordings

Recorded from the actual local OpenFilm Studio using Playwright mouse actions. The pointer, click rings and bottom captions are recording overlays. The GIFs are cropped to the timeline; the controls and waveform pixels are the actual application output.

Presets: 30%, 60%, 90%. Standalone audio retains its existing track-height behavior.

Source recording: [Alex Meets the President](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alex_Meets_the_President.webm), The White House, November 18, 2016. The source page identifies the recording as public domain. An 8-second excerpt was used; no audio gain, speed or pitch changes were applied.
